summary: Wheels Up Experience Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 6 to its 2023 Credit Agreement, under which Delta Air Lines committed an additional $100.0 million revolving credit facility available through a December 1, 2027 maturity. Interest accrues at 10% per annum on drawn balances, with a 2% per annum facility fee noted for undrawn amounts. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no equity, change of control, or strategic event is disclosed.
